info.title: Derive API
info.description:
Derive's HTTP API. Every response shape here is the single source of truth for the web client — generated from the same Zod schemas that back this reference, so the docs never drift from the running API.

**Auth:** a session cookie (browser) or a bearer token (agents and the CLI). Most write routes are scoped to the caller's active workspace. The `/v1` paths are the stable product surface; `/openapi.json` serves this spec and `/docs` renders it.

tags.name: Comments

tags.name: Proposals
tags.description: Suggested revisions awaiting review — the propose → approve / request-changes flow.

tags.name: Review

tags.name: Collections
tags.description: Shareable groups of artifacts, each with its own members.

tags.name: Sharing
tags.description: Per-artifact collaborator roles (shares) layered over the workspace baseline.

tags.name: Contexts
tags.description: Askable agent setups: wire an agent to a manifest, then open Q&A sessions against it.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Registered agents (bearer tokens) and the OAuth agents a user has authorized.

tags.name: Assets
tags.description: Standalone binary image assets referenced from bundles.

tags.name: Favorites
tags.description: The caller's favorited artifacts.

tags.name: Follows
tags.description: Follow people and repo paths to build the activity feed.

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: The caller's in-app notification feed.

tags.name: Session

tags.name: Workspace

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Custom domains and vanity subdomains bound to artifacts.

tags.name: Sync

tags.name: Slack
tags.description: Slack connection status and integration toggles.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outgoing webhooks and their delivery log.

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: OAuth 2.1 authorization-server endpoints and sign-in capabilities.

tags.name: Realtime
tags.description: Live presence and cursor sharing on an artifact.

tags.name: Analytics

tags.name: Moderation
tags.description: Abuse reports and takedown / reinstate actions.

tags.name: Vitals
tags.description: Client-reported web-vitals ingestion.

image.description: Avatar URL; null if none is set.

profession.description: Self-set team role ('what you do'); null if unset.

about.description: One-line bio; on the full profile only, null if unset.

github_login.description: Linked GitHub login; full profile only, null if not linked.

teammate.description: True when the viewer shares a workspace with this user.

stats.description: Authored-works count; present only for teammates.

followed_by_me.description: Whether the signed-in viewer follows this user.

short_id.description: Stable public id — the /a/<short_id> URL slug.

url.description: Canonical public URL of the artifact.

title.description: Display title; null when untitled or taken down.

kind.description: file = single file; bundle = multi-file archive (skill, site, or docs folder).

current_content_type.description: MIME type of the current version's content.

locked.description: When true, direct publishes are blocked — changes go through review.

workspace_access.description: v2 access: member = workspace seats reach it at their role; none = they don't.

link_role.description: v2 access: what merely holding the world link confers (none = no link).

listed.description: v2 access: where it surfaces for discovery — nowhere, the workspace, or public.

password_protected.description: true when the world link is password-locked (the password is never returned).

badge.description: Show the Made-with-Derive mark on this artifact's public surfaces (false = white-label workspace).

open_comment_count.description: Open-thread count for the sign-in-to-comment pill; present only for anonymous callers on a link that grants commenting.

public_history.description: Owner opt-in: the anonymous public page shows version history. When false, anonymous detail responses carry only the current version.

org_id.description: The artifact's workspace id; drives move-to-workspace.

raw_token.description: Signed, short-lived token for fetching raw content; detail responses only.

raw_token_expires_at.description: Expiry of raw_token as an ISO timestamp; detail responses only.

spa.description: true when the bundle is a single-page app (all paths route to the entry).

current_version.description: Latest version number; 0 before any content is published.

content_type.description: MIME type of this version's content.

author.description: Display byline; heals to the author's current name.

author_login.description: Committer's GitHub login; null when not a GitHub commit.

author_gh_id.description: Committer's GitHub user id; null when not a GitHub commit.

handle.description: Committer's Derive @handle; null unless they signed in with GitHub.

message.description: Version (commit) message; null when none given.

name.description: Optional version label; null when unnamed.

sessions.description: Versions grouped into time-clustered sessions for the UI (newest-first).

views.description: Total views; present only when analytics is enabled.

my_role.description: The caller's effective permission tier; null when they have none.

favorite.description: true when the caller has favorited this.

has_preview.description: true when the current version has a ready screenshot preview.

proposals_total.description: Count of all proposals except withdrawn ones.

mentions_me.description: true when an open thread @mentions the calling user.

i_participated.description: true when the caller authored or commented in a thread here.

collections.description: Ids of the collections that include this artifact.

collection_access.description: Collections whose sharing ADDS reach to this artifact — the share dialog's disclosure rows, renderable verbatim (the caller's own solo invite-only collection is already excluded). Detail responses only; scoped to collections the caller can see, except the artifact's managers (explicit or seat standing — never mere link-holders), who see every granting collection.

removed.description: true when the artifact has been taken down (tombstone).

archived.description: true when the artifact is on the reversible archive shelf.

managed.description: true when mirrored from a GitHub sync — read-only in Derive.

isSkill.description: true when the bundle is a skill (entry SKILL.md).

name.description: Skill/bundle name; null when not declared.

description.description: Skill/bundle description; null when not declared.

entry.description: Path of the entry document rendered first.

files.description: The bundle's file tree (path + MIME type) for navigation.

bundle.description: Present for a markdown bundle (skill or docs folder): entry, file tree, identity.

source_path.description: Source path (e.g. the repo path of a synced artifact); null when none.

derived_from.description: The artifact this one was copied from ("use as template"). Detail responses only; null when the source no longer resolves, absent when not derived.

updated_at.description: Last-update timestamp; null when never updated since creation.

author_name.description: Raw current-author name; the resolved `author` object is preferred.

author_login.description: Raw current-author GitHub login; null when not from GitHub.

author_avatar.description: Raw current-author avatar URL; null when none.

author_gh_id.description: Raw current-author GitHub id; null when not from GitHub.

login.description: GitHub login; null if never signed in with GitHub.

handle.description: Derive @handle; null when the author has none.

author.description: Resolved current-author profile; preferred over the raw author_* fields.

n.description: Newest version number in this grouped session.

from_n.description: Oldest version number in this grouped session.

count.description: How many versions this session groups.

created_at.description: Timestamp of the newest version in the group.

workspace_access.description: "member" = every workspace seat opens the artifact at their role.

my_role.description: Caller's role on the COLLECTION (owner ⇒ can manage its sharing); null if none.

member_count.description: Explicit collection-member rows (the creator always holds one).

created_by.description: Creator's user id — permanently owner of the collection.

owner_name.description: Creator's display name for attribution ("Managed by …"); null when unknown.

id.description: User id, or the agent id when kind is agent.

handle.description: The @handle; null for agents (and users without one).

kind.description: Whether this entry is a person (user) or an agent.

profession.description: The person's role; null for agents.

handle.description: Public @handle; null when the user has none.

profession.description: Joined only on workspace-member payloads; absent on artifact/collection lists.

role.description: Permission tier, ascending: viewer < commenter < editor < owner.
The caller's role in this workspace (owner = Admin).

kind.description: The invitee already had an account and was added directly.
No account yet — a pending invite was created instead.

accept_url.description: The link the invitee follows to accept.

role.description: The role the invitee will receive (owner = Admin).

workspace.description: Name of the workspace this invite joins.

role.description: The role this invite grants (owner = Admin).

email.description: The email address the invite was addressed to.

inviter.description: The inviter's display name; null if unknown.

emailNotifications.description: When true, send workspace email notifications.

githubPostComments.description: When true, post Derive comments onto the linked GitHub PR.

githubMirrorComments.description: When true, mirror GitHub PR comments back into Derive.

githubPreviewLink.description: When true, add a preview link to the linked GitHub PR.

defaultWorkspaceAccess.description: Access a new publish lands with: none, or member (factory default).

defaultLinkRole.description: Share-link role a new publish lands with (factory default: none).

defaultListed.description: Listing a new publish lands with: none (default), workspace, or public.

whiteLabel.description: Hide the Made-with-Derive marks on public artifacts and embeds, and honor the bare ?chrome=none embed.

hostedAgentsEnabled.description: Master switch for Derive-hosted agent runs; off silences every hosted run.

chatBeta.description: The Chat tab on a document, and the workspace chat. ON by default; set it false to turn chat off for a workspace entirely (the tab hides and the chat routes refuse).

chatSources.description: Connection ids the workspace's CHAT may reach through the call tool. Empty means none — connecting a server does not by itself let a conversation use it. Unattended runs are unaffected: they declare their own connections per run.

automateBeta.description: BETA: automations on a document. Off by default — the Automate entry point is hidden and the create/run/fire routes refuse, so a workspace opts in deliberately.

agentKillswitch.description: When true, every hosted agent write demotes to a proposal, instantly.

agentAutoEnabled.description: Opt-in for autonomy 'auto' to live-publish (always with a review round).

defaultAgentId.description: The workspace's default agent: the fallback actor for users with no connected agent. Absent = none.

brandprint.description: The workspace's Brandprint (conventions collection + brand-profile artifact); absent until set.

active.description: Id of the workspace this request resolved to.

AccountSummary.description: The owner's identity (id + handle); null for anonymous callers.

role.description: The caller's role in this workspace (owner = Admin).

personal.description: True for the auto-provisioned personal workspace (id ws_p_<userId>).

role.description: Permission level; commenter proposes only, editor can write, owner never allowed

hosted.description: Served by Derive's managed executor. Hosting changes where the agent runs, never its principal or cap.

managed.description: Auto-minted for one context at creation — the context's Derive access, not a user-named persona. Hidden from the roster UI.

created_by.description: The user who registered the agent — who it publishes and bills on behalf of.

owner_lend.description: When true, this agent may bill its OWNER's own model plan as a fallback (initiator -> owner -> pool). Only the owner toggles it; default off.

clientId.description: OAuth client id of the authorized agent (e.g. an MCP client like Claude)

scopes.description: The OAuth scopes this agent was granted

skipped.description: Not found, or the caller may not do this to it — not an error.

failed.description: The write was attempted but threw.

url.description: A permanent public URL for these bytes — embed it in any artifact's content

ref.description: The exact "asset:<hash>" string to drop into a publish files map

type.description: The sniffed MIME type (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, WOFF2, or WOFF)

kind.description: The person already had an account — shared directly.
No account with that email — a pending invite was created and emailed.

accept_url.description: The link the invitee follows to accept.

title.description: The artifact's title; null if untitled.

email.description: The email address the invite was addressed to.

inviter.description: The inviter's display name; null if unknown.

suggested.description: Tags from similar artifacts, most-shared first; excludes current tags.

vocabulary.description: Every tag in the workspace with its usage count, most-used first.

org_id.description: The workspace this follow is scoped to; "*" (global) for people-follows

user_id.description: The follower (the signed-in user who owns this follow)

kind.description: What's followed: a GitHub author, a repo path prefix, or a person

target.description: The followed value: author login, path prefix, or (people) public @handle

handle.description: For people-follows, the followed person's public @handle; absent otherwise

name.description: For people-follows, the followed person's display name; absent otherwise

image.description: For people-follows, the followed person's avatar URL; absent otherwise

created_by.description: Creator's user id ("anon" if created anonymously).

count.description: Number of artifacts in the collection.

link_role.description: What merely holding the canonical collection link grants.

password_protected.description: Whether the collection world link requires a password.

url.description: Canonical share URL for this collection.

my_role.description: Caller's effective role on the collection. Null if none.

can_share.description: Whether the caller has standing (not merely a world-link role) to change collection sharing.

starred.description: Whether the caller starred this collection — it pins to their sidebar.

preview.description: A few of the collection's most recent artifacts, for the filmstrip the Collections view renders. A preview strip, not a listing.

active.description: Whether the caller has worked in this collection recently — published, commented, or been added. Derived from acts that leave a row; reading is not recorded.

parentId.description: For a PR preview: the repo collection it nests under, when connected.

prNumber.description: For a PR preview: the pull-request number.

score.description: Summed neighbor-similarity votes — an ordering signal, not a probability.

created_by.description: Creator's user id ("anon" if created anonymously).

sources.description: Branch mirrors, one per connected repo.

prs.description: PR previews, one per pull request being mirrored.

configured.description: True when a live GitHub App is set up on this server.

slug.description: The App's GitHub slug for install links; absent when unconfigured.

upToDate.description: True when the App has every required permission and event.

permissions.description: Scope → level still to grant (e.g. contents → read).

events.description: Webhook event names still to subscribe to.

missing.description: Permissions and events still to grant; absent when up to date.

permissionsUrl.description: GitHub URL to adjust the App's permissions; absent when unconfigured.

approveUrl.description: GitHub URL to install or approve the App; absent when unconfigured.

app.description: The instance GitHub App's setup and permission state.

installations.description: This workspace's App installations (entry points to the repo picker).

collection_id.description: Collection the repo's docs are mirrored into.

repo.description: The connected GitHub repo, as owner/name.

ref.description: Branch or tag to mirror; "HEAD" tracks the default branch.

includes.description: Comma-separated glob patterns selecting which files to mirror.

token.description: Redacted to "•••" when a PAT is stored; null for App-backed sources.

installation_id.description: GitHub App installation backing this source; null when using a PAT.

last_synced_at.description: When the last sync finished; null if it has never synced.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last sync run; null if it has never synced.

file_count.description: How many files are currently mirrored from the repo.

progress.description: Live sync progress as a JSON blob driving the bar; null when none recorded.

collection_id.description: Collection holding this PR's previewed docs.

repo.description: The connected GitHub repo, as owner/name.

pr_number.description: The pull request number this preview mirrors.

title.description: The PR's title, used as the preview's display name.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last sync run; null if it has never synced.

last_synced_at.description: When the last sync finished; null if it has never synced.

file_count.description: How many of the PR's changed docs are mirrored.

progress.description: Live sync progress as a JSON blob driving the bar; null when none recorded.

installation_id.description: GitHub's numeric App installation id, as a string.

account_login.description: The org/user the App is installed on; null until GitHub reports it.

full_name.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

private.description: True when the repo is private on GitHub.

pushed_at.description: When the repo was last pushed to; null if unknown. Drives sort order.

total.description: Total files matching the include globs.

md.description: How many matches are Markdown files.

html.description: How many matches are HTML files.

other.description: Matches that are neither Markdown nor HTML.

truncated.description: True when GitHub capped the tree, so counts are a lower bound.

repo.description: The connected GitHub repo, as owner/name.

progress.description: Live sync progress as a JSON blob driving the bar; null when none recorded.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last sync run; null if it has never synced.

last_synced_at.description: When the last sync finished; null if it has never synced.

file_count.description: How many files are currently mirrored from the repo.

available.description: True if this instance has Slack configured at all

connected.description: True if this workspace has connected a Slack team

team_name.description: The connected Slack team's name, or null if not connected

needs_reauth.description: Whether the stored bot token needs a re-auth — a failed auth/scope call, or Slack reporting the app uninstalled or its token revoked

slack_dm.description: The caller's "DM me for interrupts" preference (mentions, review requests, shares)

linked.description: Whether the caller has linked their Slack identity for the connected team

channel_name.description: The channel's #name for display, or null if unknown

scope_kind.description: Whether this covers the whole workspace or one collection

scope_id.description: The collection id when scope_kind is "collection"; empty for a workspace scope

scope_title.description: The scoped collection's title, resolved for display. Null for a workspace scope, and also when the collection has been deleted — the subscription then matches nothing, and saying so is more useful than a bare id.

events.description: Comma-separated event types to deliver, or "*" for all events

authors.description: Whose activity reaches this channel: everyone, only people, or only agents

active.description: Whether deliveries are enabled (1) or paused (0)

user_id.description: The recipient this notification belongs to

actor.description: Who triggered it; for follow/publish this is the person's @handle

kind.description: What happened: mention, comment, share, follow, publish, or review

artifact_short_id.description: The artifact's public short id for links; empty for follows (no anchor)

artifact_title.description: The artifact's title, or null if untitled or not artifact-anchored

thread_id.description: The comment thread anchor; empty when not comment-related

comment_id.description: The specific comment anchor; empty when not comment-related

preview.description: Short text preview shown in the notification bell

read.description: Whether the user has read it: 0 unread, 1 read

reason.description: The reporter's stated reason for the report

detail.description: Optional extra detail from the reporter, or null

reporter.description: The reporter's IP (best-effort), or null; abuse reports are anonymous/public

state.description: open (awaiting review), actioned (taken down), or dismissed (no action)

action.description: What happened: report filed, takedown, reinstate, or dismiss

artifact_id.description: The artifact acted on, or null if not artifact-specific

actor.description: Who performed it: a user's name, or an IP/'anonymous' for public reports

detail.description: Context such as the report reason or takedown note, or null

t.description: Line op: ctx = unchanged context, add = added, del = removed.

line.description: The line's text; the +/- marker lives in `t`, not here.

state.description: Review state: open, approved (went live), changes_requested, or withdrawn.

author.description: Proposer's display name; "anonymous" if not signed in.

on_behalf_of.description: When an agent proposed, the human it acted on behalf of; null for a direct human proposal.

message.description: Proposer's cover message; null if none.

base_version.description: Artifact version this proposal was authored against.

kind.description: Content shape: a single file or a multi-file bundle.

decided_by.description: Who approved/requested-changes/withdrew it; null while still open.

decided_version.description: The version it went live as when approved; null otherwise.

decision_note.description: Reviewer's note on the decision; null while open or if none.

decided_at.description: When it was decided; null while still open.

preview_url.description: URL that renders the proposed content like a live version.

diff.description: Line diff vs the base version; present only on the single-proposal fetch.

version.description: The artifact version this round is reviewing.

requested_by.description: Who asked for the review (usually the agent that published).

requested_for.description: The person asked to answer or approve this round.

state.description: Round state: pending, sent_back (answers returned), or approved (the go-signal).

note.description: Free-text note attached to the round; null if none.

resolved_by_name.description: The human who settled the round; null while pending or for legacy history.

resolved_at.description: When it was sent back or approved; null while pending.

thread_id.description: The thread this comment belongs to; equals id for the thread's root comment.

base_version.description: Artifact version this comment was anchored against.

path.description: File within a bundle the comment targets; null if not file-scoped.

anchor.description: Serialized text-quote or element anchor locating the comment; null if unanchored.

body_md.description: Comment body in Markdown; blanked when the comment is deleted.

author.description: Author's display name; "anonymous" for an anonymous poster.

state.description: Thread state: open, addressed (a proposal in review claims to fix it), resolved, or outdated (the quoted text changed).

anchored.description: Whether the anchor still resolves against the current version (list only).

reactions.description: Emoji → list of reactor display names.

edited.description: True if the body was edited after posting.

edited_at.description: When the comment was last edited; null if never.

deleted.description: True if soft-deleted; the row stays but the body is blanked.

mentions.description: Users or agents @mentioned in the comment body.

id.description: Id of the mentioned person or agent.

agent_id.description: The registered agent this context routes asks to.

manifest_short_id.description: Short id of the linked manifest artifact; null if it can't be resolved.

runner_seen_at.description: When the runner last polled the queue (~minutely); null = never. Drives online/offline.

ask_policy.description: Who in the workspace may ask: any member, or the invited roster. Never outside the workspace.

connection_ids.description: Connections this context may use — its tools, in every lane it runs in.

description.description: The manifest's own first paragraph — frontmatter and a single leading heading stripped, capped. Null when the manifest has none or can't be read.

skills_count.description: How many skills the manifest's frontmatter pins.

manifest_version.description: The manifest artifact's current version; null if it can't be resolved.

profile_short_id.description: The workspace brand-profile artifact (an HTML page carrying theme tokens), when set; null otherwise. Not in `members` — it is the headline read, not a note.

version.description: The member's current version at fetch time (provenance).

is_skill.description: A skill bundle (materialize into skills/) vs a prose note.

members.description: Convention artifacts: skills to materialize, notes to read. Excludes the profile.

pinned.description: The pinned version; null = unpinned (runs current).

current.description: The skill artifact's current version; null if it can't be resolved.

stale.description: True when the pin trails the artifact's current version.

context_id.description: The packaged agent answering, or null when the default agent is.

context_version.description: The manifest version this session opened against; null with no context.

state.description: open = awaiting the agent; working = a runner claimed it and is answering; answered; escalated = draft went to review; failed = run crashed; closed = ended by asker/owner.

updated_at.description: Last state/message change; equals created_at when never updated.

subject.description: What this session is about, when it names one: an artifact, plus how a write to it lands. Null for a plain ask.

result_artifact_id.description: The artifact this session's answer bound as its result, if any.

asker_username.description: The asker's public handle. Only resolved on the owner's view of the sessions list — a picker of your own sessions already knows who you are.

lane.description: 'local' when this session's MOST RECENT agent turn was recorded rather than served through the queue (see SessionMeta.lane) — a session recorded once and later genuinely followed-up through the queue reads as null again, because the turn that answer describes changed. Only resolved on the owner's view of the sessions list.

author_kind.description: Who wrote it: asker (the human) or agent (the context's runner).

author_id.description: The asker's user id, or the agent id when author_kind is agent.

query.description: The underlying query the agent ran to produce this answer.

confidence.description: The agent's confidence in the answer, 0-1 (shown as a percentage).

caveats.description: Caveats or limitations the agent flagged on its answer.

escalation_reason.description: Why the agent escalated to a human instead of answering.

artifacts.description: Artifacts the agent cited, each linkable by short_id.

tools.description: Which tools the turn actually ran, in order of first use. Names only: arguments can carry the contents of a private document, and this is persisted on the message. This is what lets a surface show HOW an answer was reached rather than only asserting that it searched.

model.description: Which model produced this answer. Recorded per message rather than per session because the choice is per turn — a conversation can be continued on a different model, and the answers it already gave must keep saying which model wrote them.

outcome.description: How the turn ended: answered, published, proposed, or failed.

cost_micro_usd.description: Reported spend for the turn in millionths of a USD; null when unreported.

lane.description: Stamped on a recorded answer: work that already ran on the owner's own machine, filed here rather than served through the queue. Mirrors automate record's run.meta.lane. Absent on every normally-served turn.

card.description: The public context draft from the last builder tool call on this turn.

SessionMeta.description: Structured answer payload on agent messages; null on asker messages.

id.description: The provider's model id — what to send back to pick it.

is_default.description: The one a turn uses when nobody chose.

id.description: The viewer's id: a signed-in user's id, or a stable anonymous viewer id

name.description: Display name: a user's @handle, or a friendly handle for anonymous viewers

role.description: The viewer's effective role on this artifact, or null if they have none

total.description: Total recorded views across all versions (de-duped opens)

unique.description: Distinct viewers; a signed-in person or anon cookie counts once

anonViewers.description: How many of the unique viewers are anonymous

viewer.description: Display name (resolved @handle for users), or the anon viewer id

kind.description: Whether the viewer is a signed-in user or anonymous

avatar.description: The user's avatar URL, or null/absent for anonymous viewers

artifact_id.description: The artifact this webhook is scoped to, or null to fire on all workspace events

url.description: The destination endpoint deliveries are POSTed to

kind.description: Delivery format: generic posts signed JSON, slack posts a Block Kit message

events.description: Comma-separated event types to deliver, or "*" for all events

label.description: Optional human-readable label, or null if unnamed

active.description: Whether deliveries are enabled (1) or paused (0)

status.description: Delivery state: pending (awaiting/retrying), delivered (succeeded), dead (gave up)

attempts.description: Number of delivery attempts made so far

last_error.description: The most recent failure message, or null if none

host.description: The hostname the artifact is served at.

url.description: That host with scheme, ready to link to.

kind.description: "subdomain" = a vanity <label>.<base>; "custom" = a workspace custom domain.

host.description: The custom domain attached to the workspace.

records.description: DNS records to add while pending; absent once the domain is active.

type.description: DNS record type to create (e.g. CNAME).

name.description: The name/host to create the DNS record at.

value.description: The value the DNS record should point at.

password.description: True if email + password sign-in is available (always on here)

google.description: True if Google sign-in is configured

github.description: True if GitHub sign-in is configured

providerId.description: The provider id used to initiate SSO

label.description: Human-readable label for the SSO button

oidc.description: The enterprise OIDC/SSO provider, or null if none is configured

emailVerification.description: True if verification emails can be sent (a mail transport is configured)

passwordReset.description: True if password-reset emails can be sent

passkey.description: True if passkey (WebAuthn) sign-in works on this instance

get.summary: The signed-in user + their active-workspace role.

200.description: The current user (SessionUser + role) and whether multi-workspace is on.
